messages:
jamie: heads-up — UX for per-tenant alert snoozes landed in staging. It's showing predicted churn numbers and cost impact per tenant. thoughts?
ravi: nice — where is the predicted churn coming from?
jamie: from the notify-preview pipeline; we simulate fanout given thresholds, sampling, and routing rules. returns estimate of recipients and token usage.
sasha: is this the soft-snooze behavior (gradual suppression) or the hard-snooze we had before? we need both exposed.
jamie: both. console defaults to soft (decay), you can choose hard. stack path: routing-policy -> notify-service -> deliverer.
mel: concern: notify-api routing is currently global tier-based. we don't have a per-tenant quota-aware routing hook. exposing per-tenant overrides might trigger huge fanout changes.
ravi: proposal: add a quota-aware routing step: if tenant_quota_util > 80% then route to low-fidelity tier (coalesced digest) else normal. Telemetry drives the decision.
sasha: +1. UI needs an 'alert fidelity' slider that previews recipients & estimated monthly notify-cost. users must see tradeoffs.
jamie: UX has the slider. the problem: prod-safety doesn't want too many internal knobs surfaced by default. they want safe defaults and a preview that explains consequences.
mel: internal API debate: should console call a server-side endpoint /admin/notify-preview or run a client-side simulation library? Server-side avoids leaking implementation and can use real telemetry, but adds latency.
ravi: server-side is safer. return a small preview object clients can show. sample response shape we discussed:
```
{
  "recipients_count": 24,
  "estimated_tokens": 12000,
  "routing_hint": "coalesce:digest-4h"
}
```
sasha: also need persistence: per-tenant preference saved and tied to rollout stages. e.g., when enabling feature canary, set fidelity low to reduce alert noise during early rollout.
jamie: engineering question: telemetry needs a metric like notify_cost_estimate per tenant so routing decisions can be automated. right now telemetry aggregates hide tenant_id for privacy.
mel: we can emit an internal-only per-tenant metric (prometheus) but require opt-in / legal signoff. ops: @ravi can you file a tiny RFC describing retention and access controls?
ravi: on it — draft RFC: https://go/repo/rfc/notify-tenant-estimates (will link to PR)
alert-bot: Deploy started for staging (deploy-1234) :rocket:
jamie: staging deploy looks ok, but preview times out when a tenant has many routes (500+). we should cap preview generation to 200 routes and show an 'approx' badge.
sasha: agreed. add a "simulate noise" toggle that runs offline sampling (1000 windows) for a fuller churn estimate.
mel: final asks for console: document default suppression policy in help text, surface estimated notify-cost in the rollout preview, and make "apply to historical alerts" a separate explicit checkbox.
jamie: I'll update the help copy and the staging build. thanks team :thumbsup:
